props.description: One Sunday a month, a team from New Life worships at another Grand Rapids church, prays for them, and hands over a letter and a gift.

props.heading: Church Ambassador Teams
props.lede: One Sunday a month we go and worship at another church in Grand Rapids — not to recruit anyone, and not to fix anything. To pray for them, and to say out loud that we are one Church in this city.

props.heading: We go as guests, not as visitors.
props.subline: The fourth Sunday of the month
props.body:
Every month one Grand Rapids church becomes the church we pray for. Our whole congregation prays for them by name, all month. Then on the fourth Sunday a team from New Life shows up at their service, sits in their pews, sings their songs, and worships under their pastor.

We bring two things with us: a letter telling that church what we have been praying for them, and a gift of $200 toward whatever they are already doing. Then we stay in touch — their pastor is in our prayers long after the Sunday is over.

facts.label: When
facts.value: The fourth Sunday of the month

facts.label: How long
facts.value: One service — you are home by lunch

facts.label: What we bring
facts.value: A letter of encouragement and a $200 gift

facts.label: Who can go
facts.value: Anyone. Families, students, first-timers — you are a guest, not a volunteer

cards.title: We choose the church
cards.text: One church in Grand Rapids, picked a month ahead, and we ask their pastor what they would want prayed for.

cards.title: The whole church prays
cards.text: They go up on the screen on Sunday and into the reminders our Dream Team gets all month. You do not have to go to be part of this.

cards.title: A team goes on the fourth Sunday
cards.text: We arrive together, worship with them, and let their service be their service.

cards.title: We hand over the letter and the gift
cards.text: A written letter of encouragement and $200 toward their work — given to their leader, in person.

cards.title: We stay connected
cards.text: Their pastor stays on our prayer list, and their church stays on the map. This is not a one-Sunday relationship.

props.title: One Body. One witness.
props.body:
Two of our five commitments are to unite the Church and to reveal Jesus to this city. Those are easy to agree with and hard to actually do, because doing them means going somewhere that is not ours and being glad about it.

Grand Rapids does not need one more church competing for a Sunday morning. It needs churches that pray for each other by name and can prove it. That is all this is — the vision, with a date on the calendar.

props.title: Pick a month.
props.body: Tell us you want to go and we'll let you know which church, when to be there, and what to expect. You can come once or come every month.
